_meta.title: SOVEREIGN COMPUTE REGISTRY
_meta.owner: CSOAI LTD (16939677) — UK micro SME, bootstrapped, non-academic
_meta.method: 5 parallel research sweeps, primary sources only. Every entry carries a status + the catch.
_meta.honesty_rule: status=works means VERIFIED usable by THIS profile. dead/blocked/gated are kept deliberately — knowing what NOT to chase is the point. No padding.

entries.name: UKRI AIRR Rapid Access
entries.catch: 3-month use window from award, cannot defer. R&D only — NOT product deployment. No cash.
entries.verdict: APPLY — biggest prize. UK SME + Companies House number is the ONLY gate.

entries.name: EuroHPC AI Factories — Playground
entries.free_allowance: 5,000 GPU hrs (LUMI-G / MareNostrum5 / Leonardo / Vega / MeluXina / Discoverer)
entries.catch: Needs VAT number (+PIC for some routes). Civilian only. R&D scope.
entries.verdict: DO FIRST — fastest real compute on earth for this profile. INDUSTRY-ONLY: academics redirected, so being non-academic is an ADVANTAGE. SMEs may COMMERCIALLY EXPLOIT outcomes + keep data/models. UK = 35th Participating State (May 2024) — eligibility SETTLED vs primary list.

entries.name: EuroHPC AI Factories — Fast Lane
entries.catch: Same as Playground
entries.verdict: Step up to this once a known user.

entries.name: EuroHPC AI Factories — Large Scale
entries.catch: Expert-evaluated (competitive)
entries.verdict: The ceiling. Needs a real track record first.

entries.name: Sovereign AI Unit — compute
entries.catch: EITHER/OR with AIRR AI Open Access — not both. Realistically selective.
entries.verdict: APPLY — compute strand is NOT equity-gated (that's the separate £500M fund). Named priority: 'AI Trust, Integrity & Assurance' = CSOAI's exact category.

entries.name: UKRI AIRR Gateway Route
entries.catch: R&D scope
entries.verdict: Legitimate SECOND bite — different pot from Rapid Access. UK business ANY size, no academic partner.

entries.name: UKRI AIRR AI Open Access Call
entries.catch: CLOSED 4pm 17 Jul 2026. Either/or with Sovereign AI.
entries.verdict: MISSED this round — watch for reopen.

entries.name: UKRI AIRR Innovator Route
entries.catch: CLOSED (ran Nov 2025–Jan 2026), no reopen date
entries.verdict: Best mid-size route when it returns. Email airr@ukri.org to be notified.

entries.name: UK AI Assurance Innovation Fund
entries.catch: Competitive
entries.verdict: ⭐ THE STRATEGIC ONE — non-dilutive AND credential-conferring, for 'novel assurance mechanisms'. Best fit for the ONLY surviving moat (independence). DSIT states none of ~161 UK assurance firms are UKAS-accredited.

entries.name: Modal
entries.catch: Ephemeral containers — persist to modal.Volume or git. CLI broke once (venv deleted) — token survived.
entries.verdict: PROVEN SUBSTRATE — trained the whole trinity for ~$0.15. `modal shell x.py::train` = free interactive GPU shell.

entries.name: Kaggle Notebooks
entries.free_allowance: 30 GPU-hr/WEEK, T4x2 (2x16GB) or P100, 9–12h sessions, 20GB persistent
entries.catch: Needs kaggle.json for API automation. No native SSH (tunnel is hacky/fragile).
entries.verdict: BEST FREE ALLOWANCE ANYWHERE, no card. CLI installed 2026-07-17; `kernels push` = scriptable GPU jobs.

entries.name: Scaleway
entries.catch: Card required
entries.verdict: ⭐ BEST genuinely-free real LoRA run. Self-serve, EU.

entries.name: Google Colab
entries.catch: Quota UNPUBLISHED ('limits vary'). Idle-kill, no background exec.
entries.verdict: 7B yes, 14B marginal. Checkpoint or lose it.

entries.name: Lightning.ai
entries.catch: ACCOUNT BILLING-BLOCKED (support code 03920104). NO support button — support is a paid/enterprise feature. Also: ?settings=keys breaks the pricing page into a Not-Found state (dead buttons).
entries.verdict: Real native SSH Studios, but blocked for us. '80 free GPU hours' is T4-only marketing — real unit is 15 credits.

entries.name: Intel Tiber AI Cloud
entries.catch: Quota UNVERIFIED. Needs Optimum-Habana, NOT the CUDA path — real friction.
entries.verdict: No card. Worth a look if CUDA-free is acceptable.

entries.name: Beam
entries.catch: UNVERIFIED — pricing page now shows only Team $89/mo. Free 'Developer' tier claimed only in their own blog.
entries.verdict: Test before relying.

entries.name: TPU Research Cloud
entries.free_allowance: free TPU v4/v5, ~30d renewable, by application
entries.catch: TPUs free but VM+GCS BILLED TO YOU. JAX/torch-xla only — LoRA tooling awkward.
entries.verdict: Real but awkward.

entries.name: SageMaker Studio Lab
entries.catch: CLOSING TO NEW CUSTOMERS 30 Jul 2026
entries.verdict: Door closing. Don't build on it.

entries.name: Saturn Cloud
entries.catch: Free tier GONE from plans page
entries.verdict: Listicles citing '30 free hours' are recycling a 2023 press release.

entries.name: Paperspace / DO Gradient
entries.catch: Usable P4000/P5000 need PAID plan. Being folded into DO GPU Droplets.
entries.verdict: Free tier is a DECOY — 8GB Maxwell, no bf16/FlashAttention.

entries.name: RunPod
entries.catch: Signup bonus requires $10 DEPOSIT first; ~96% of referral bonuses pay $5–10
entries.verdict: 'Up to $500 free' is AFFILIATE BAIT.

entries.name: Cerebrium
entries.catch: 'Hobby: Free' = free PLATFORM FEE, compute billed
entries.verdict: Not free GPU.

entries.name: Banana.dev
entries.catch: SHUT DOWN 31 Mar 2024
entries.verdict: DEAD. Still on listicles.

entries.name: Genesis Cloud
entries.catch: Site 404s; German records: GmbH i.L. (IN LIQUIDATION) since Aug 2025
entries.verdict: DEAD. Listicles are recommending a corpse.

entries.name: Vast.ai
entries.catch: Startup Program is a SPEND-MATCH not a grant; they screen OUT people 'seeking free compute without committed spending'
entries.verdict: '$2,500 free' misrepresents a spend-match.

entries.name: Salad
entries.catch: NO free trial. CREDIT CARD ONLY — debit/prepaid REJECTED. Interruptible nodes.
entries.verdict: Cheapest 24GB (~$0.18/h 4090) but not free.

entries.name: Lepton AI
entries.catch: ACQUIRED BY NVIDIA (→DGX Cloud Lepton). Founder departed Jun 2026.
entries.verdict: No self-serve free tier.

entries.name: DataCrunch / Verda
entries.catch: RENAMED to Verda (datacrunch.io 301s). No free tier.
entries.verdict: Alive, paid only.

entries.name: OVHcloud
entries.catch: 1-MONTH EXPIRY. GPU eligibility UNVERIFIED (inferred from absence of exclusion).
entries.verdict: Test cheap before committing a run.

entries.name: Nosana
entries.catch: Crypto network; 3090 ~$0.19/h
entries.verdict: Only no-application freebie in crypto.

entries.name: Prime Intellect
entries.catch: Needs genuine open-research angle. Live grants page UNVERIFIED.
entries.verdict: ⭐ 'Anyone from anywhere can apply'. Highest self-serve ceiling. $130M Series A Jul 2026 — very alive.

entries.name: Akash
entries.catch: Trial EXCLUDES H100/H200/A100/4090/5090 — every card you'd want
entries.verdict: Don't plan around it.

entries.name: Gensyn
entries.catch: Mainnet is a PREDICTION MARKET; RL Swarm paused. You cannot rent a GPU.
entries.verdict: STRIKE.

entries.name: Render Network / Bittensor / Golem
entries.catch: Category errors — 3D render farm / incentive network, not GPU rental. No shell, no custom training.
entries.verdict: STRIKE. 'Dispersed AI training' claim is unsourced marketing.

entries.name: Spheron
entries.catch: Pivoted — own docs say 'Spheron is not a blockchain network'
entries.verdict: 🔍 THE TELL: Spheron's blog PUBLISHES the 'Free GPU Credits 2026' listicles that rank for these searches. That's SEO content, not an offer. The '100 free sites' lists are largely an SEO artefact.

entries.name: Baidu AI Studio
entries.free_allowance: daily sign-in = 8h V100-32GB / 16h V100-16GB / 2h A100-40GB; +48h signup; ~120h w/ referrals
entries.catch: REAL-NAME BLOCKED: accepts only Chinese 2nd-gen ID / foreign PERMANENT-RESIDENCE permit / HK-Macau-Taiwan permit / Chinese passport. A UK passport is NOT on the list. Also PaddlePaddle-only — PyTorch wiped on restart.
entries.verdict: GENUINELY the most generous free GPU on earth, and genuinely unreachable. The wall is IDENTITY, not payment — which is why 'just use a VoIP number' advice stops one step short.

entries.name: Alibaba PAI-DSW
entries.free_allowance: trial CU-hours on A10-24GB/V100 (⚠️5,000 CU-h figure is STALE; current docs say 750)
entries.catch: aliyun.com real-name (Alipay auth / face recognition + 身份证). GOTCHA: auto-converts to pay-as-you-go on expiry — REAL BILL RISK.
entries.verdict: Biggest miss in western lists, and blocked.

entries.name: ModelScope
entries.catch: Requires Alibaba Cloud binding + real-name
entries.verdict: Ideal QLoRA spec. Blocked.

entries.name: Alibaba Cloud International
entries.catch: PAI/DSW GPU trial eligibility UNVERIFIED
entries.verdict: The ONLY unblocked lead into the Chinese ecosystem (takes passports + Visa/MC). Worth 10 min of testing.

entries.name: Tencent Cloud Studio
entries.catch: China-site only; non-CN docs routed to international site where free GPU doesn't exist
entries.verdict: Blocked.

entries.name: AutoDL
entries.catch: +86 phone ONLY
entries.verdict: Blocked, and tiny anyway.

entries.name: Huawei ModelArts
entries.catch: CPU-only free flavor (verified in docs)
entries.verdict: Dead end regardless of region.

entries.name: Groq
entries.catch: gpt-oss-120b is a REASONING model — starves and returns EMPTY at low max_tokens. Use max_tokens>=300.
entries.verdict: ⭐ FREE 120B VERIFIED WORKING (openai/gpt-oss-120b). Also llama-4-scout (MoE), qwen3.6-27b, llama-3.3-70b. Earlier 'unreachable' was OUR bug.

entries.name: NVIDIA NIM
entries.catch: OUR KEY: lists 116 models but ALL inference returns 403 'Authorization failed' = account entitlement/credits issue, NOT code. Docs say no-card/PHONE-VERIFY — phone verification may be the fix.
entries.verdict: Best free LARGE-model access (DeepSeek-R1 671B, GLM-5 744B) IF entitled. 405b 404s on this account; target deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-pro.

entries.name: OpenRouter
entries.catch: Models ROTATE; DeepSeek/Kimi :free tags REMOVED
entries.verdict: Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B (1M ctx) free.

entries.name: Cerebras
entries.catch: ⚠️ Blogs + the free-llm-api-resources list claim 30 RPM and free Qwen3-235B — OFFICIAL DOCS SAY 5 RPM and Qwen3-235B is NOT on the free tier.
entries.verdict: gpt-oss-120b, zai-glm-4.7. The 1M TPD is real; the RPM figure isn't.

entries.name: Mistral
entries.catch: 2 RPM is painful
entries.verdict: Huge token quota, unusable rate.

entries.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
entries.catch: Neurons drain fast on big models
entries.verdict: Nemotron 3 120B, Llama 3.3 70B.

entries.name: Google AI Studio
entries.catch: Params undisclosed
entries.verdict: Gemini Flash is a legitimately strong aggregator — worth testing.

entries.name: SambaNova
entries.catch: 20 requests/DAY
entries.verdict: Serves DeepSeek-V3.1 671B but 20 RPD = useless for MoA.

entries.name: Cohere
entries.catch: NON-COMMERCIAL USE ONLY
entries.verdict: Command A (111B) but licence blocks CSOAI use.

entries.name: Hugging Face Inference
entries.catch: Effectively dead as free tier
entries.verdict: ZeroGPU (25min/day H200) needs $9/mo Pro — that IS good value.

entries.name: GitHub Models
entries.catch: 8K input cap kills MoA fan-in
entries.verdict: Alive but limited.

entries.name: Chutes
entries.catch: FREE TIER KILLED Mar 2026 (~11K users, $0 revenue)
entries.verdict: DEAD.

entries.name: Anyscale Endpoints
entries.catch: DEAD since Aug 2024
entries.verdict: DEAD.

entries.name: Together AI / Fireworks / DeepInfra / Hyperbolic / Novita
entries.catch: Together: $5 min purchase, no real free tier. Fireworks: $1 trial, card to lift 10RPM. DeepInfra: card/pre-pay required. Hyperbolic: promo only. Novita: ~$0.50.
entries.verdict: No standing free tiers.

entries.name: Oracle Cloud Free Tier
entries.free_allowance: 2x AMD micro VMs (always free) + Ampere A1 ARM 2 OCPU/12GB (HALVED from 4/24 on 15 Jun 2026) + 200GB block + 10TB egress
entries.catch: CPU ONLY — no GPU. A1 halving was never publicly announced; PAYG-upgraded accounts MAY have kept 4/24 (UNVERIFIED).
entries.verdict: RUNNING our sovereign-hermes brain (always-on, signed). Our box is the AMD micro — A1 halving does NOT affect us. Best always-on free compute despite the cut.

entries.name: GitHub Codespaces
entries.catch: CPU only
entries.verdict: Free for all accounts. Good for data prep.

entries.name: Render
entries.catch: Spins down after 15min idle, ~1min cold start
entries.verdict: THE ONLY SURVIVING PaaS FREE TIER.

entries.name: Google Cloud Free
entries.catch: e2-micro is us-west1/central1/east1 only
entries.verdict: $300 trial is real.

entries.name: AWS Free Tier
entries.catch: REWRITTEN Jul 2025 — 12-month-free + always-free now only for pre-15-Jul-2025 accounts. Unused credits VANISH at 6mo.
entries.verdict: Worse than it was.

entries.name: Azure Free
entries.catch: 1 per customer
entries.verdict: Fine.

entries.name: IBM Cloud Lite
entries.catch: Lite instances DELETED after 30 days inactivity
entries.verdict: No card for Lite.

entries.name: Fly.io
entries.catch: FREE TIER DEAD — now 2 VM-hours or 7-day trial
entries.verdict: DEAD.

entries.name: Railway
entries.catch: No free tier since 2023; prepaid removed early 2026 → post-paid card mandatory
entries.verdict: DEAD.

entries.name: Gitpod / Ona
entries.catch: Gitpod Classic PAYG SHUT DOWN 15 Oct 2025; rebranded to Ona
entries.verdict: Core from $10/mo.

entries.name: Hetzner
entries.catch: No free tier, paid day 1
entries.verdict: Cheapest real ARM/x86 (20TB egress incl EU) if you ever pay.

entries.name: AWS Activate Founders
entries.catch: <10 employees, <$1M rev/funding, <10yrs, pre-Series B, NO VC/accelerator affiliation, no prior Activate
entries.verdict: ⭐ BOOTSTRAPPED IS THE QUALIFYING CONDITION. Apply.

entries.name: Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub
entries.catch: Higher tiers ($25K–$150K) are stage/traction-gated
entries.verdict: ⭐ Best no-gate credit. Solo founders + pre-revenue EXPLICITLY OK.

entries.name: Google for Startups Cloud
entries.catch: $20K–$350K tiers REQUIRE accelerator/VC affiliation
entries.verdict: Take the $2K; ignore the headline numbers.

entries.name: NVIDIA Inception
entries.free_allowance: free membership + $10K DLI credits + 30% off DGX Cloud + partner credits (Nebius 'AI Lift' up to $150K, partner-discretion)
entries.catch: Incorporated, <10yrs, not public, working website, >=1 developer
entries.verdict: ⭐ NO EQUITY, NO FEE, bootstrapped explicitly eligible. The partner-credit door is the real prize.

entries.name: Modal Startup Program
entries.catch: Pre-seed/seed/Series A
entries.verdict: ⭐ NO VC REFERRAL REQUIRED. Already a known-good substrate.

entries.name: Intel Liftoff
entries.free_allowance: Tiber AI Cloud credits (amount UNVERIFIED) + mentorship
entries.catch: Credit amount undisclosed
entries.verdict: No equity, no fee. Low-cost apply.

entries.name: Together AI Accelerator
entries.catch: Partner-linked tiers get more
entries.verdict: Apply, expect the low end without a partner.

entries.name: AWS Activate Portfolio
entries.catch: REQUIRES VC/accelerator/incubator affiliation — HARD GATE
entries.verdict: ❌ DO NOT CHASE. Founders tier is your only door.

entries.name: Oracle for Startups
entries.catch: Portal folded into Free Tier after 2022 restructure; remaining allocations run through APPROVED VC/ACCELERATOR partnerships
entries.verdict: ❌ Effectively closed to bootstrapped.

entries.name: CoreWeave Startup Accelerator
entries.catch: 'National in scope, so applicants across the U.S. may apply' — reads US-only. UK eligibility UNVERIFIED/likely blocked.
entries.verdict: ❌ Probably not for you.

entries.name: Lambda
entries.catch: 'Research Grant up to $5,000' appears only in aggregator listings — UNVERIFIED, treat as noise
entries.verdict: No published open programme.

entries.name: Cambridge CSD3
entries.catch: Cambridge-internal rates published (55p/GPU-hr A100); EXTERNAL rates unpublished
entries.verdict: The one facility with a plain commercial door. But Dawn is reachable FREE via AIRR — don't pay first.

entries.name: ARCHER2 (EPCC)
entries.catch: 🚨 SERVICE ENDS 21 Nov 2026, no successor announced
entries.verdict: Not worth the sales cycle.

entries.name: DiRAC
entries.catch: Academic-only AND domain-locked to astro/particle physics. 'Industry' page = co-design partnerships; they sell no compute.
entries.verdict: ❌ STRIKE.

entries.name: JASMIN
entries.catch: NERC-funded academics only
entries.verdict: ❌ STRIKE.

entries.name: Bede
entries.catch: N8/EPSRC academics only; V100-era anyway
entries.verdict: ❌ STRIKE.

entries.name: Sulis
entries.catch: 🚨 UKRI funding ENDED 31 Mar 2026 — likely defunct
entries.verdict: ❌ STRIKE.

entries.name: Baskerville
entries.catch: Academic-only AND OFFLINE being rebuilt with B200s until EARLY 2027
entries.verdict: ❌ Recheck Q1 2027.

entries.name: Digital Catapult Machine Intelligence Garage
entries.catch: DEAD — URL 301-redirects to a past-tense case study. No application route exists.
entries.verdict: ❌ STRIKE.

entries.name: NCC UK / EuroCC
entries.catch: DEAD FOR UK — EuroCC@UK ended Dec 2022; Brexit ruled UK out of EuroCC2. No UK equivalent of other countries' free consultancy hours.
entries.verdict: ❌ STRIKE.

entries.name: Innovate UK BridgeAI
entries.catch: ENDED June 2026
entries.verdict: ❌ STRIKE.

entries.name: Alan Turing Institute
entries.catch: 🚨 REQUIRES >=5 EMPLOYEES — being a genuine micro business is the DISQUALIFIER
entries.verdict: ❌ Blocked on headcount, not merit.

entries.name: Digital Catapult Applied AI Growth Sprints
entries.catch: Min team of 3 — blocked on headcount
entries.verdict: ❌ No compute anyway.

entries.name: UK AISI / Alignment Project
entries.catch: Closed; 'unlikely to run a similar program in 2026'; drifting academic
entries.verdict: ❌ Don't build a plan around it.

entries.name: Hartree Centre / HNCDI
entries.catch: No open EXPLORE call, no public rate card. Free SME hubs only in NI/Cardiff/NE England. ⚠️£5k HPC voucher (Bridging for Innovators) MAY exist — source 403'd, framed as 2025. UNVERIFIED.
entries.verdict: Email hartree@stfc.ac.uk to confirm the voucher.

entries.name: DASA
entries.catch: Open Call CLOSED pending transition to UK Defence Innovation (~Jul 2026). UNVERIFIED whether reopened.
entries.verdict: Relevant to DEFONEOS as FUNDING; irrelevant to compute.
